Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from all of us for this game, we hope you enjoyed our coverage of the game. It was a historic game for Bangladesh and they have now made it a memorable one as well. They will aim to carry this confidence into the shorter formats of the game. The first ODI between these two sides starts on March 25, 2017  in Dambulla at 1430 local (0900 GMT). We look forward to your company. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Sri Lankan skipper, Rangana Herath says that you don't get a gift on every birthday. Congratulates Bangladesh on the win. Adds that they could not capitalize as a batting unit. Opines that they need to improve in every aspect of the game in Test cricket. (On taking 1000 First Class wickets) Says that he feels good for now but is not sure how long will he last.

Bangladesh skipper, Mushfiqur Rahim feels that it was a great win. Credits the players and coaches for backing them. Adds that the spell from Mustafizur Rahman and Shakib Al Hasan were outstanding and hopes that this sets them well for future. He calls it frustrating to not make most of the chances under pressure in the first game but is happy that they are starting to get better. Calls it a team effort to win the game. Opines that this is the coming of age in Test cricket for Bangladesh as they have started to play consistent cricket. Hopes that they can carry on the good work.

Man of the Series, Shakib Al Hasan feels that it was a very important victory for them. Admits that it was difficult but he is happy that they did it. Opines that he gave a thought on his batting which helped him to score big. Also adds that he looked into Chandimal's batting which helped him a lot.

Man of the Match, Tamim Iqbal informs that the win started when they lost the first game. They had a meeting before this game and it was the game changer. Adds that all the players were brilliant, cheering the team on. On the chase, he says that they had to be aggressive chasing such totals. Opines that on such wickets one ball can take you out and that was what he and Sabbir talked about. Credits Mosaddek for playing really well. Adds that the coach always backs them to play their natural game and they are lucky to have someone like him.

Chasing 191, Tamim Iqbal led them from the front scoring a belligerent 82. He along with Sabbir Rahman calmed the nerves of the visitors with a 109-run stand. But both of them departed before Tea. Needing 35 more runs in the final session, it looked like it would be a walk in the park but that was not to be. Shakib Al Hasan was bowled. There were some nervous moments but the pair of Mosaddek Hossain and Mushfiqur Rahim hit a few lusty blows to calm the nerves down and Mehedi Hasan finished the game off for them.

The hosts were always playing catch up since then and despite the ton from Dimuth Karunaratne, they were behind the eight ball. Mustafizur Rahman and Shakib Al Hasan ran through the middle order and it looked like the game might get over on Day 4 itself. The tail however wagged for Sri Lanka with the last three wickets adding as many as 102 runs to set up a target of 191.

A lot of the good work was done in the first innings itself both with the bat and ball. They kept Sri Lanka to a score of 338 with Dinesh Chandimal playing brilliantly for his ton. With the bat, it was Shakib Al Hasan who led them to post a total in excess of 400 and gaining a 129-run lead. Soumya Sarkar, Mushfiqur Rahim, Mosaddek Hossain all chipped in with vital fifties.

BANGLADESH HAVE WON THEIR 100th TEST! What a brilliant Test match it has been and they have come out victorious. Historic scenes at the P Sara Oval, it is the first time they have drawn a series against Sri Lanka! They have had a lot of second innings failures in recent times but this chase of 191 runs should really boost their confidence as it has come against a good Sri Lankan side.

The players are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Sabbir Rahman walk out to bat. 153 runs more needed for them. Sri Lanka begin the session with Rangana Herath. Here we go...
Day 5.... Session 2....

The hosts, on the other hand, will bank on their skipper Rangana Herath to lead them from the front. There is assistance from the deck but not too much. The odds are in favour of the visitors but the fifth day surface, pressure of a chase, you never know. Cricket is a game of glorious uncertainties and the hosts will want to believe in it. Join us in a while for what should be a decisive penultimate session of the day.

Test cricket, you beauty! 153 runs, 8 wickets in hand - this is turning out to be one epic Test. Bangladesh began cautiously and a sudden moment of laziness cost them a couple of wickets but Tamim Iqbal is still out there and that will calm the nerves of the visitors.
Floated around off, Rahman reaches to the pitch of the ball and defends it on the off side. That's LUNCH ON DAY 5.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman drives it through the mid on region for a single.
Spinning into the pads, Rahman works it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up outside off, Rahman prods forward in defence.

NOT OUT! Floated around off, Tamim just lofts it over the cover fielder for a single. The fielder from sweeper cover has a throw at non-striker's end. de Silva has a cheeky flick into the stumps and appeals. The umpires go upstairs to check the run out. Replays show Tamim had his bat in.
There is a run out appeal against Tamim at the non-striker's end. Looks not out.
Floated outside off, Rahman pushes it towards mid off.
A bit short outside off and spinning in, Iqbal camps back and adjusts well to clip it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Outside off, Iqbal drives it to covers.
Looped up outside off, Iqbal lunges forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller this time, Tamim prods forward to defend it.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide outside off, Iqbal camps back and punches it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Much needed runs! Tossed up around leg, Rahman kneels forward and converts it into a full toss to paddle it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
A bit fuller outside off, Rahman punches it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Again sprayed on the pads, Iqbal clips it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball to defend it.
On the stumps, Tamim prods forward and defends it.
Full outside off, Tamim drives it back to the bowler.
Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl now.
Spinning into the stumps, Rahman gets an inside edge onto the pads.
In the line of the stumps, Rahman gets forward to defend it.
Whizzes past the edge! Tossed up outside off, Rahman lunges forward to defend but fails to counter the spin. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Rahman prods forward and defends it.
Full into the pads, Iqbal clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Iqbal prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Rahman stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Down the leg side, Rahman defends it.

NOT OUT! Just got back in time! Floated around off, Tamim drives it towards the mid off region and rushes for a single. The fielder there picks it up quickly and throws it back to the keeper's end. Dickwella has too much work to do but he still manages to dislodges the bails quickly. The umpires go upstairs to check the run out. Sabbir Rahman just got back in time and complete the single.
There is a run out appeal at the striker's end against Sabbir. Looks not out.
Down the leg side this time, Iqbal defends it on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning in from a length outside off, Iqbal stays in his crease and defends it.
Flighted around off, Rahman lunges forward to defend it.
Again in line of the pads, Rahman camps back and pushes it on the leg side.
On the leg side this time, Rahman defends it in front of the fielder at short leg.
Rahman gets in line of the ball and defends it.
Floated around off, Rahman prods forward in defence but fails to counter the spin. The ball spins away and just misses the edge.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Sabbir prods forward and defends the hat-trick ball.
Herath on a Hat-Trick! First slip, short leg in place.
Flighted outside off, Tamim gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it towards covers.
Outside off, Sabbir gets off the mark as he pushes it through point for an easy single.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Iqbal prods forward in defence and gets an inside edge which goes fine down the leg side for a single.
Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Tamim gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Iqbal prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up around off, Iqbal camps back and defends it off his crease.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in.

OUT! Two in two for the skipper! Floated outside off, Imrul Kayes lunges forward and tries to defend it. He fails to read the spin well and gets a thick outside edge which goes straight to the fielder at slip. Asela Gunaratne makes no mistake to send the batsman back to the hut for a golden duck. The Sri Lankans are excited.
Imrul Kayes is the new man in.

OUT! Sarkar throws it away! Tossed up outside off, Sarkar charges down the wicket to go big but he fails to make the contact he desired. He gets a top edge which flies towards the fielder at long off. Upul Tharanga comes ahead a touch, gets under it and takes a simple catch. Birthday boy draws first blood.
Spinning in from outside off, Sarkar lunges forward to defend it but he totally misses it and the ball thuds onto his pads. Sharp turn there.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar gets forward and defends it.
Pitched around leg, Tamim gets forward and clips it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal shuffles across and defends it off the back foot.
Floated around middle and leg, Sarkar gets forward to defend but only manages to get it of the inner half of his bat.
Tossed up around off, Sarkar stays in his crease and defends it.
Sarkar prods forward and defends the ball.
Looped up outside off, Sarkar pushes this one towards the fielder at point.
Way down the leg side, Sarkar still tries to clip it but misses.
Floated around off, Tamim prods forward in defence and gets an inside edge which flies through the vacant leg gully region. The batsmen run three in the process.
A bit full into the stumps, Sarkar clips it towards the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar dances down and drives it firmly to the fielder at mid off.
Angling down the leg side, Sarkar misses his flick and gets rapped on his pads. A mild appeal is denied.
Off the back foot, Tamim punches it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal blocks it away towards point.
Spinning in from way outside off, Tamim gets behind the line off the ball and punches it towards mid on.
Spinning into the pads, Sarkar defends this one in front of the fielder at short leg.
A bit shorter in length this time, Sarkar camps back and defends it.
Looped up on the stumps, Sarkar prods forward in defence.
FOUR! Soumya takes the charge! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Sarkar charges forward to counter the spin and smacks it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Down the leg side, Iqbal gets it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
On the leg side, Iqbal clips it on the leg side.
Iqbal stays deep in his crease and punches it through mid on to keep the strike with a single.
Short outside off, Iqbal gets it back to the bowler off the inner half.
That's missed the edge again. Tossed up outside off, Iqbal tries to defend it but he plays for the spin this time. The ball does not spin much and goes straight to the keeper.
Spinning into the stumps, Iqbal leans forward and defends it.
Around off, Iqbal leans forward and drives it towards covers.
Floated outside off, Iqbal gets an outside edge which rolls away towards the slip fielder.
Another play and a miss, Sarkar is having a troubled outing here.

FOUR! Edged and four! Sarkar is having a tough stay in the middle. Floated in the line of the stumps, Sarkar tries to defend it. The ball flies off the outside edge and goes through the slightest of gap between the keeper and slip.
Again misses the edge! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Soumya prods forward and hangs his bat in defence. The ball spins away and misses the edge as it goes through to the keeper.
A bit short into the pads, Tamim camps back and glances it through the mid-wicket region for a triple. Suranga Lakmal cuts it across and saves a run for his team.
Down the leg side this time, Soumya clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Looped up in the line of the stumps, Sarkar reaches out to the ball and defends it.
Iqbal gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Full into the pads, Sarkar gets his first runs on the boards as he eases it down towards long on for a single.
Full outside off, Iqbal reaches out to it and blocks it towards point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, Tamim leans forward and drives it towards covers.
Rangana Herath, the birthday boy to bowl from the other end.
Flighted in the line of the stumps, SS gets to the pitch of the ball and defends the last ball of the over.
In the line of the pads, Sarkar defends it on the leg side.
That's just missed the edge! Tossed up around off, the ball spins away a bit. Sarkar prods forward in defence and he is lucky not to edge it.
Floated outside off, Soumya camps back and pushes the ball on the off side.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Sarkar stays in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Sprayed on the pads, Tamim Iqbal clips it through the mid-wicket region to get off the mark with a single.
